name: 51101 · Sioux City, IA
findings: ZIP 51101 (Sioux City) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51101 (Sioux City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 51101 (Sioux City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
